description: Fraction of candidate SMILES passing Lipinski Ro5 + Veber + ring-count >= 1 strict gate (lower is harder to pass) — PRODUCTION cohort of 449 metallo-drug SMILES from molmetal/data/metallo_drugs_500_train.csv
scope: Lambda MCTS candidate pool — production (449 metallo-drug SMILES from Wf-303C ADMET pass-through cohort)

aggregate.gap_curated_vs_prod: curated smoke 0.7 (10 hand-picked SMILES) vs production 0.1737 (449 SMILES, metallo-drug cohort) — curated value is biased upward (smoke set was selected to be drug-like); production value is the honest cohort-level drug-likeness measurement.

verdict: MEASURED — pharmacophore_pass_rate_prod strict_pass_rate=0.1737 (n=449 metallo-drug SMILES from Wf-303C ADMET cohort). Lenient_pass_rate=0.3786. Mean violations per mol = 1.7238307349665924. Curated smoke (n=10) was 0.7 — biased upward as expected; production is the honest cohort-level drug-likeness number.

comparison_to_curated.interpretation: Production value is LOWER than curated smoke, as expected — the 10 curated SMILES were hand-picked to be drug-like; the 449-mol metallo-drug cohort includes larger / acyclic / metal-organic structures (cisplatin, Pt(PPh3)4, etc.) that fail the strict gate. The production value is the honest cohort-level measurement.

honest_framing_note: PRODUCTION cohort — replaces the curated 10-SMILES smoke (MEASURED 0.7) with a 449-SMILES metallo-drug cohort from Wf-303C ADMET pass-through data. Per party-twenty-spirit §3.5, the curated smoke was biased upward (hand-picked to be drug-like); the production value is the honest cohort-level drug-likeness number for metallo-drug generation. Use production value as the headline number; curated 0.7 retained as an upper-bound sanity check.
